# clean

```{r}
df_surg_prf <- df_surg_prf %>%
  rename(YEAR = "YEAR_str") %>%
  mutate(VALUE = replace_na(VALUE, 0))
```


```{r}
df_pop_prf <- df_pop_prf %>%
  rename(PRF = "PRF_en") %>%
  mutate(ID = paste0(YEAR, "_", PRF))
```


```{r}
# add region

df_pop_prf <- df_pop_prf %>%
  left_join(df_surg_prf %>% 
              distinct(iso_3166_2, REG),
            by = join_by(iso_3166_2))
```


# pancreas

```{r}
df_surg_prf %>% 
  filter(str_detect(CLASS_code, "^K702|^K703|^K704")) %>%
  count(CLASS_code, CLASS_name, PRO_code, PRO_name)
```


```{r}
df_panc_prf <-  df_surg_prf %>% 
        filter(str_detect(CLASS_code, "K700|^K702|^K703|^K704")) %>%
  mutate(TX = case_when(str_detect(PRO_name, "腹腔鏡") & !str_detect(PRO_name, "手術用支援機器") ~ "Lap",
                        str_detect(PRO_name, "腹腔鏡") &  str_detect(PRO_name, "手術用支援機器") ~ "Robotic",
                        .default = "Open") ) %>%
  
  
  mutate(LOC = case_when(str_detect(PRO_name, "膵頭") ~ "Head",
                         str_detect(PRO_name, "膵体尾部") ~ "Distal",
                         str_detect(PRO_name, "全摘") ~ "Total",
                         CLASS_code %in% c("K700", "K700-4") ~ "Middle",
                         CLASS_code %in% c("K700-2", "K700-3") ~ "Partial")) %>%
  mutate(TX = factor(TX, levels = c("Open", "Lap", "Robotic"))) %>%
  mutate(LOC = factor(LOC, levels = c("Head", "Distal", "Total", "Middle", "Partial")))
```

```{r}
# check total

df_surg_prf %>%
  filter(str_detect(CLASS_code, "^K704"))  %>%
  group_by(YEAR) %>%
  summarise(VALUE = sum(VALUE)) %>%
  left_join(df_surg_prf %>%
              filter(str_detect(CLASS_code, "^K704"))  %>%
              distinct(PRO_name, YEAR, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
              select(YEAR, TOTAL),
            by = join_by(YEAR)) %>%
  mutate(DIF = (VALUE- TOTAL)/TOTAL * 100 )
```



```{r}
df_panc_prf %>%
  filter(YEAR == "2023") %>%
  group_by(YEAR, PRO_name) %>%
  summarise(SUM = sum(VALUE)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  left_join(df_panc_prf %>%
              filter(YEAR == "2023") %>%
              distinct(YEAR, PRO_name, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
              select(PRO_name, TOTAL),
            by = join_by(PRO_name)) %>%
  summarise(SUM = sum(SUM),
            TOTAL = sum(TOTAL)) 
```

```{r}
df_panc_total <- df_panc_prf %>%
  distinct(YEAR, PRO_name, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  group_by(YEAR) %>%
  summarise(SUM_total = sum(TOTAL))

df_panc_total
```

```{r}
df_panc_value <- df_panc_prf %>%
  group_by(YEAR) %>%
  summarise(SUM_value = sum(VALUE))

df_panc_value
```


# what is the source of decline in 2017?

```{r}
df_panc_total_2017 <- df_panc_prf %>%
  filter(YEAR == "2017") %>%
  group_by(PRO_code, PRO_name) %>%
  summarise(SUM_value = sum(VALUE)) %>%
  left_join(df_panc_prf %>%
              filter(YEAR == "2017") %>%
              ungroup() %>%
              distinct(PRO_code, SHEET, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
              select(PRO_code, TOTAL),
            by = join_by(PRO_code))
  
```

```{r}
df_panc_prf %>%
  filter(YEAR == "2017" & PRO_code == "150296910") %>% 
  select(SHEET, PRO_name, TOTAL, VALUE) %>% View()
```


```{r}
df_panc_total_2017 %>%
  mutate(LOC = case_when(str_detect(PRO_name, "膵頭") ~ "Head",
                         str_detect(PRO_name, "膵体尾部") ~ "Disal",

```

```{r}
df_panc_total %>%
  left_join(df_panc_value,

  mutate(PCT = (SUM_value - SUM_total)/SUM_total * 100)
```

```{r}
df_panc_prf_loc <- df_panc_prf %>%
  filter(!LOC %in% c("Total", "Middle", "Partial")) %>%
  group_by(YEAR, LOC, iso_3166_2, PRF) %>%
  summarise(SUM = sum(VALUE)) %>%
  bind_rows(df_panc_prf %>%
              group_by(YEAR, PRF, iso_3166_2) %>%
              summarise(SUM = sum(VALUE)) %>%
              mutate(LOC = "All")) %>%
  mutate(LOC = factor(LOC, levels = c("All",
                                      "Head",
                                      "Distal")))
```

```{r}
df_panc_prf_loc <- df_panc_prf_loc %>%
  mutate(ID = paste0(YEAR, "_", iso_3166_2)) %>%
  left_join(df_pop_prf %>%
              mutate(ID = paste0(YEAR, "_", iso_3166_2)) %>%
              rename(POP = "ALL_total") %>%
              select(ID, POP),
            by = join_by(ID)) %>%
  ungroup()

df_panc_prf_loc 
```

```{r}
df_panc_prf_loc <- df_panc_prf_loc %>%
  mutate(ADJ = SUM/POP * 10^2) 
```


```{r}
df_panc_prf_loc  %>% group_by(PRF) %>%
  slice_max(SUM, n = 1) %>%
  arrange(desc(SUM))
```

```{r}
df_sum_scales <- df_panc_prf_loc %>%
  group_by(PRF) %>%
  slice_max(SUM, n = 1) %>%
  distinct(PRF, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(ymax = case_when(SUM <100 ~ 100,
                         SUM >= 100 & SUM < 150 ~ 150,
                         SUM >= 150 & SUM < 200 ~ 200,
                         SUM >= 200 & SUM < 250 ~ 250,
                         SUM >= 250 & SUM < 300 ~ 300,
                         SUM >= 300 & SUM < 400 ~ 400,
                         SUM >= 400 & SUM < 500 ~ 500,
                         SUM >= 500 & SUM < 800 ~ 800,
                         SUM >= 800 & SUM < 1000 ~ 1000,
                         SUM >= 1000 & SUM < 1200 ~ 1200,
                         SUM >= 1200 & SUM < 1500 ~ 1500,
                         SUM >= 1500 & SUM < 2500 ~ 2500,
                         .default = NA
                         )) %>%
  ungroup()
```

```{r}
nrow(df_sum_scales)
```


```{r}
df_sum_scales <- df_sum_scales %>%
  mutate(n = case_when(ymax %in% c(250, 500, 1000, 2500) ~ 5,
                       ymax %in% c(150, 300, 1500) ~ 3,
                       ymax %in% c(100,200,  400, 800, 1200, 2000) ~ 4,
                       .default = NA)) %>%
  mutate(ymin = rep(0, 47))
```

```{r}
df_sum_scales <- df_sum_scales %>% 
  mutate(range = ymax/n)
```


```{r}
df_sum_scales %>% count(ymax, n)
```

```{r}
df_sum_scales_split <- split(df_sum_scales, df_sum_scales$PRF)
```


```{r}
sum_scales <- lapply(df_sum_scales_split, function(x) {
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, x$ymax),
                     breaks = base::seq(0, x$ymax, x$range),
                     labels = label_comma())
})
```


```{r}
s1 <- df_panc_prf_loc %>%
  filter(LOC != "Total") %>%
    filter(!(YEAR == "2017" & LOC %in% c("Distal", "All")) ) %>%
  mutate(YEAR = as.numeric(YEAR)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(YEAR, SUM, colour = LOC, group = LOC)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.3)+
  facet_wrap2(vars(PRF),
              scales = "free_y",
              remove_labels = "all",
              axes = "all",
              nrow = 8, ncol = 6)+
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(2014, 2024),
                     breaks = seq(2014, 2024, 5),
                     labels = c("2014",
                                "2019",
                                "2024"))+
  ggh4x::facetted_pos_scales(y = sum_scales)+
  
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("#8c564b",
                                 "#1f77b4",
                                 "#d62728"),
                      name = "Pancreatectomy")+
   theme_classic()+
  guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(linewidth = 0.5) ) )+
  labs(x = "Year",
       y = "**n**")+
  theme(strip.background = element_blank(),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 8, colour = "black", face = "bold",
                                  margin = margin(1, 0, 1, 0, "mm")),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 8, colour = "black", face = "bold"),
        axis.title.y = element_markdown(size = 8, colour = "black"),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8, colour = "black"),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8, colour = "black"),
        axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 0.3, colour = "black"),
        axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 0.3, colour = "black"),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 8, colour = "black", face = "bold"),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 8, colour = "black"),
        legend.position = "right",
        legend.direction = "vertical",
        legend.key.spacing.y = unit(0, "mm"),
        legend.box.spacing = unit(0, "mm"),
        legend.key.height = unit(1, "line"),
        legend.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0, "mm"),
        plot.margin =margin(0, 0, 0, 0, "mm"),
        panel.spacing = unit(1, "mm"))

s1
```

```{r}
s1_leg <- s1 %>% get_legend() %>% wrap_elements()

s1_leg
```

```{r}
s1_no_leg <- s1 + theme(legend.position = "none")

s1_new <- s1_no_leg + inset_element(s1_leg,
                                    left = 0.875,
                                    right = 1,
                                    bottom = 0,
                                    top = 1/8,
                                    align_to = "full")

s1_new
```


```{r}
ggsave("../figure/FigS1.svg", s1_new,
       width = 174, height = 234, units = "mm")
```

```{r}
)
```

```{r}
convert_label <- function(x){
  if (x %in% c("SUM")){
    return("**n**")
  }
  
  else if (x %in% c("ADJ")){
    return("**n/10<sup>5</sup> people**")
  }
  
  else {
    return(NA)
  }
}

convert_label <- Vectorize(convert_label)
```

```{r}
# man kendall test on raw values


df_panc_prf_loc_rkt <- df_panc_prf_long_na    %>%
  
  
  mutate(YEAR = as.numeric(YEAR)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  nest(data = -ID) %>%
  mutate(
    model = purrr::map(data, ~ rkt(date = .x$YEAR,
                                 y = .x$VALUE)),
    tau = map_dbl(model, "tau"),
    p_value = map_dbl(model, "sl"),
    slope = map_dbl(model, "B")
  )

df_panc_prf_rkt

```

```{r}
levels_prf <- df_surg_prf %>% distinct(PRF) %>% arrange(PRF) %>% pull(PRF) %>%
  as.character()
```

```{r}
get_exp <- function(x){

  if (x > 0.001){
    
    return("")
  }
  
  else {
  
    p <- formatC(x, digits = 1, format = "e", flag = "#")
    
    ex <- p %>% str_extract("(?<=e).+") %>% str_remove_all("(?<=\\-)0+")
    
    return(ex)
  }
}

get_expv <- Vectorize(get_exp)
```

```{r}
get_num <- function(x){

    if (x > 0.001){
    
      p <- formatC(x, digits = 2, format = "fg", flag = "#")
      
      return(p)
  }
  
  else {
  
    p <- formatC(x, digits = 1, format = "e", flag = "#")
    
    num <- p %>% str_extract(".+(?=e)")
    
    num <- str_c(num, "×10")
      
    return(num)
  }
}

get_numv <- Vectorize(get_num)
```

```{r}
df_panc_prf_res <- df_panc_prf_res %>%
 mutate(slope_label = case_when(abs(slope) < 10 ~ formatC(slope, digits = 2, format = "fg", flag= "#"),
                                 .default = round(slope) %>% as.character())) %>%
  mutate(slope_label = str_replace(slope_label, "\\.$", "\\.0$")) %>%
  
  mutate(tau_label = formatC(tau, digits = 2, format = "fg", flag = "#")) %>%
  
  mutate(tau_label = str_replace_all(tau_label, "-", "−")) %>%
  
  mutate(slope_label = str_replace_all(slope_label, "-", "−")) %>%
  
  mutate(p_symbol = case_when(p_value < 0.001 ~ "***",
                              p_value < 0.01 ~ "**",
                              p_value < 0.05 ~ "*",
                              .default = "")) %>%
  
  mutate(label_slope = paste0("beta == '", slope_label, "'" )) %>%
  
  mutate(label_tau = paste0("tau == '", tau_label,  p_symbol, "'")) %>%
  
  mutate(y_slope = 0.2,
         y_tau = -0.2)
```

```{r}
convert_strip <- function(x){
  if (x == "SUM"){
    return("**n**")
  }
  
  else if (x == "ADJ"){
    return("**n/10<sup>5</sup> people**")
  }
  
  else {
    return(x)
  }
}

 convert_strip <- Vectorize(convert_strip)
```

```{r}
p1_d <- df_panc_prf_res %>%

  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#74add1",
                      mid  = "white",
                      high = "#f46d43",
                      limits = c(-1, 1),
                      breaks = c(-1, -0.5, 0, 0.5, 1),
                      labels = c("–1.0", "–0.5", "0.0", "0.5", "1.0"),
                      name = expression(tau))+
  
  geom_text(aes(label = label_slope,
                nudge_y = y_slope),
            size = 2.8, colour = "black",
            parse = TRUE)+
  
  geom_text(aes(label = label_tau,
                nudge_y = y_tau),

  facet_grid2(rows = vars(Y),
```
